exposure: Maternal bile acid levels (<40 micromol/litre vs. >40 micromol/litre)
cohort: 54 pregnant patients with history of pruritus, abnormal liver function tests, and bile acid levels >10 micromol/litre
finding: Increased maternal bile acid levels (>40 micromol/litre) are associated with adverse perinatal outcomes in pregnancies with IHCP.
